name: AgenteARQ for Codex
notes: Project configuration remains subject to Codex workspace trust and host policy. This integration does not change approval or sandbox settings. Installation adds SessionStart, PreToolUse and Stop hooks to .codex/hooks.json that call `agentarch hook --host codex`; Codex runs them only after the user reviews and trusts them with /hooks, and a hook cannot ask for approval there, so owner-only actions are denied.
